title: Down the Mine
goals: Reach Mine floor 5 and Quarry floor 5
reward: 1,500g, the Cutter’s plans, a recruit and 250 Farm Rank points

scenes.title: The Boarded-Up Mine
outline: Gus Talbot at the boarded-up Mine; he pries off the boards and lights his lamp
Floor by floor: “the stairs don’t find themselves: dig the deepest floor and you’ll find the way down”; your best miner goes first
The Quarry next door gives stone and the odd gem
Where a smelter could stand, and what it would make of the ore

scenes.title: Floor Five
outline: Gus on floor 5, pleased, and he leaves you his lamp
He unrolls the Cutter’s plans for the Quarry
Your newest hand at the Gate
A smell of baking drifts up from town: Rosa Bell; chapter 4 Soon
